context: A literature teacher and a teen discuss a classic detective novel
purpose: Teach: 殺害/銃/爆弾/解雇/死者/探偵/悲劇/単独

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: この探偵小説、読み終わった？密室での殺害事件が見事に描かれてるでしょう。
lines.en: Did you finish this detective novel? The murder case in the locked room is brilliantly portrayed, isn't it?
lines.style: Warm teacher tone, inviting curious engagement from student

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、読みました！でも犯人が単独犯だなんて、最後まで全然気づかなかったです。
lines.en: Yes, I finished it! But I didn't notice at all until the end that the culprit was a lone offender.
lines.style: Excited teen voice, slightly breathless with admiration

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そうよね。被害者は銃で撃たれたように見せかけて、実は時限爆弾を使ったというトリックも秀逸ね。
lines.en: Right? The trick of making it look like the victim was shot, when actually a time bomb was used, is also exquisite.
lines.style: Thoughtful, savoring the literary craftsmanship aloud

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あぁ、あの場面ですよね！死者の手紙が出てくるところ、本当に鳥肌が立ちました。
lines.en: Oh, that scene! When the dead person's letter appears, I really got goosebumps.
lines.style: Animated teenage enthusiasm, almost shivering with memory

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 主人公は不当解雇されたことへの恨みから動き出すのだけど、その心理描写こそ歴史的悲劇と呼ぶにふさわしいの。
lines.en: The protagonist is driven by resentment over being unjustly fired, and that psychological portrayal truly deserves to be called a historic tragedy.
lines.style: Reflective, lecturing gently with deep literary respect

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生、未だに信じられないんですけど、あの結末って作者の実体験がもとになってるとかいう噂、本当ですか？
lines.en: Teacher, I still can't believe it, but is that rumor true that the ending was based on the author's real experiences?
lines.style: Curious whisper, leaning in like sharing a secret

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ふふ、それは諸説あるわね。でも一見フィクションに見えても、文学には作家の魂が必ず宿るものよ。
lines.en: Heh, there are various theories on that. But even if it looks like fiction at first glance, a writer's soul always dwells in literature.
lines.style: Knowing chuckle, wise mentor sharing literary wisdom warmly
